segments.textEn: So I'm going to go through the kind of a high level overview. I think it's been a really great year for Tesla and I think there's even better years to come. So I'm going to talk about that and then try to answer. I think there's 20 questions that we have on the list that were submitted by Twitter. There's certainly some really interesting questions that were submitted and some interesting correlations that were drawn.
segments.textZh: 所以我会先做一个高层次的概述。我认为，对 Tesla 来说，这是非常棒的一年，而且我认为未来还会有更好的年份。所以我会谈谈这个，然后尽量回答问题。我想我们的清单上有 20 个通过 Twitter 提交的问题。其中当然有一些非常有意思的问题，也有人提出了一些有意思的关联。

segments.textEn: We couldn't get to them all. But we'll try to get to, I think the 20 that I think are most significant for the year ahead of us.
segments.textZh: 我们没法全部回答。但我想，我们会尽量回答其中对未来一年最重要的 20 个问题。

segments.textEn: So really the, one of the key things that happened this year is the beginning of the transition of Tesla to a fully integrated sustainable energy company where you have solar creating the energy, then the stationary battery pack, the power wall and power pack storing the energy and then that energy being used in an electric vehicle. Now the great thing about this is it answers all. It's a fully contained energy solution that could scale for the whole world.
segments.textZh: 所以实际上，今年发生的关键事情之一，就是 Tesla 开始向一家完全一体化的可持续能源公司转型，由太阳能产生能源，然后由固定式电池组、Powerwall 和 Powerpack 储存能源，再把这些能源用于电动汽车。这里最棒的一点是，它回答了所有问题。这是一套完全自成一体的能源解决方案，可以扩展到全世界。

segments.textEn: And I'm getting to that for a moment. But it's something where you can imagine as far in the future, well beyond human civilization, which I hope lasts a really long time, that this is something that would last for really, you know, this works. And I think there are no unanswered questions. Even the gigafactory or the gigafactories that make these products will be powered by sustainable energy. So like, I really don't think there's any hole left in the argument, you know, because when we're making electric cars, people would say that, well, they're just, they're really coal powered and there's like the long tailpipe, you know, and the type tailpipe's really over there by the power plant.
segments.textZh: 我一会儿会讲到这一点。但这是这样一种东西：你可以想象，在遥远的未来，远在人类文明之后，我希望人类文明能延续非常久，这种东西真的会一直延续下去，你知道，这是行得通的。而且我认为已经没有任何未解答的问题了。甚至制造这些产品的超级工厂，也就是那些超级工厂，都将由可持续能源供电。所以，像是，我真的不认为这个论点里还留有任何漏洞，你知道，因为当我们制造电动汽车时，人们会说，嗯，它们只不过是，它们其实是靠煤炭驱动的，而且就像有一根很长的排气管，你知道，而那种排气管其实就在那边的发电厂旁。

segments.textEn: We're like, yeah, but you know, we're going to have sustainable energy generation too.
segments.textZh: 我们就说，是的，但你知道，我们也会有可持续能源发电。

segments.textEn: So with the solar roof, the solar roof we're really trying to address at the residential level one of the fundamental inhibitions of adding solar, which is aesthetics. People love their homes, they want their homes to be beautiful. And if you've got a sloped roof home, that means you have to have solar integrated into the roof itself.
segments.textZh: 所以对于太阳能屋顶，我们真正试图在住宅层面解决安装太阳能的一项根本阻碍，也就是美观问题。人们热爱自己的家，他们希望自己的家很漂亮。而如果你住的是斜屋顶住宅，那就意味着你必须把太阳能集成到屋顶本身之中。

segments.textEn: And so what we created here, I think is something that's going to be incredibly revolutionary, where it's beautiful. In fact, I think it looks better than a normal roof. In doing this, we were trying to find examples of roofs and it's like, man, take a look at roofs. Next time you're driving down the road, you're like, whoa, they're not good.
segments.textZh: 所以我认为，我们在这里创造的东西将具有难以置信的革命性，因为它很漂亮。事实上，我认为它看起来比普通屋顶更好。做这件事时，我们试图寻找一些屋顶的例子，感觉就像，伙计，看看那些屋顶吧。下次你沿着公路开车时，你会觉得，哇，它们可不好看。

segments.textEn: So this is a roof that's going to be better looking than a normal roof.
segments.textZh: 所以，这种屋顶会比普通屋顶更好看。

segments.textEn: It's going to last practically forever.
segments.textZh: 它实际上将能永久使用。

segments.textEn: Like, I wanted to have an infinite year warranty, but then the finance department said, well, that's difficult to account for.
segments.textZh: 比如，我本来想提供无限年质保，但财务部门说，嗯，这很难入账。

segments.textEn: So I said, well, okay, it's infinite. Or when your house falls down, whichever comes first, get the message across, but basically last forever. You think of like a cathedral with stained glass windows. Those stained glass windows are about the only thing, and the stone walls, the only thing that's lasted over half a millennium.
segments.textZh: 所以我说，嗯，好吧，那就是无限期。或者直到你的房子倒塌，哪个先发生就以哪个为准，把意思传达清楚，但基本上就是能永久使用。你可以想想带有彩色玻璃窗的大教堂。那些彩色玻璃窗大概是唯一的东西，还有石墙，是唯一历经半个千年仍然保存下来的东西。

segments.textEn: So great looking, durable, affordable, when you consider the cost of a roof and the cost of electricity from the utility. And this is going to vary quite a lot by region. So it depends on what property taxes are, what the cost of financing is, and what the cost of power from the utility is. But we're confident that this is going to be something that is either actually makes you money or is close to break even for most of the country, which I think is really, really profound.
segments.textZh: 所以它外观漂亮、耐用、价格实惠，只要把屋顶的成本以及公用事业公司的电费考虑进去。而这会因地区不同而有很大差异。所以这取决于房产税是多少、融资成本是多少，以及公用事业公司的供电成本是多少。但我们相信，对全国大多数地区来说，这种东西要么实际上能为你赚钱，要么接近盈亏平衡，我认为这真的、真的意义深远。

segments.textEn: Now, there's still a very important role for the traditional kind of flat panel.

segments.textEn: And so that's still going to be a very important part of our business going forward. Because whenever you've got a flat roof situation, which is most commercial installations are flat roofs and. You can't see it. So that's. I just want to emphasize that traditional solar is still going to be very important part of the business going forward.
segments.textZh: 所以展望未来，那仍将是我们业务中非常重要的一部分。因为只要是平屋顶的情况，而大多数商业设施采用的都是平屋顶，而且。或者，如果住宅采用平屋顶，并且从街上看不到，那就没有必要使用太阳能玻璃瓦，因为美观已不再是一个因素。你看不见它。所以就是这样。我只是想强调，展望未来，传统太阳能仍将是业务中非常重要的一部分。

segments.textEn: Also, if somebody's got a brand new roof that they probably don't want to replace the roof right away and it's still going to make sense to have retrofit solar. And, you know, these are the, what you're seeing Cycling through are the kind of, the first four, and we're starting off with two, which is the kind of the, the black slate and the textured slate. And then hopefully by early next year we'll be in production with the Spanish tile and the French slate versions.
segments.textZh: 另外，如果有人有一个全新的屋顶，他们可能不想马上更换屋顶，那么加装太阳能仍然是合理的。而且，你知道，你现在看到轮流展示的这些，是最初的 4 种，我们会先从其中 2 种开始，也就是那种，那种黑色板岩和纹理板岩。然后希望到明年年初，我们能开始生产西班牙瓦和法国板岩版本。

segments.textEn: And there will be more over time. But the overarching goal here is to have a set of products or a set of roof products where if you were driving through a neighborhood and you looked at the roofs, you said, wow, I really like the way this, those roofs look. Roofs don't get a lot of attention, but we want something, we want to create. It's like if you can imagine the future and what it looks like, that that's something that you want.
segments.textZh: 随着时间推移，还会有更多。但这里的总体目标是提供一套产品，或者说一套屋顶产品，让你开车经过一个社区并看着那些屋顶时，会说，哇，我真的很喜欢这个，那些屋顶的样子。屋顶并没有得到太多关注，但我们想要某种东西，我们想要创造。就像如果你能想象未来以及它是什么样子，那就是你想要的东西。

segments.textEn: And obviously that needs to be paired with stationary storage with a battery pack. The battery packs are important for a number of reasons and they.
segments.textZh: 显然，它需要与采用电池组的固定式储能相配套。电池组之所以重要，有很多原因，而且它们。

segments.textEn: Because the solar. Solar power peaks during the middle of the day and then it's low at dawn and dusk and it's not there at night. So you need something that is load leveling the power so it's storing it when there's high power generation, releasing it when you, when you have low power generation. And this is going to be important for grid stability as solar scales so there's more and more solar. It's more and more critically important that there be batteries to load level the grid and enable a full transition to sustainable energy.
segments.textZh: 因为太阳能。太阳能发电在一天的中午达到峰值，然后在黎明和黄昏时较低，夜间则不存在。所以你需要某种东西来均衡电力负荷，在发电量高时将其储存起来，在你，在发电量低时将其释放出来。而且随着太阳能规模扩大，太阳能越来越多，这对电网稳定将十分重要。拥有电池来均衡电网负荷并实现向可持续能源的全面转型，会变得越来越至关重要。

segments.textEn: So that. Oh, and then it has a greater, a great advantage, which I think is the kind of thing where you only really notice it when the power's out. Like there are frequent power outages because a substation went down or a bird flew into wires or. In many parts of the world, power is intermittent and they have to have generators which run on very expensive diesel fuel.
segments.textZh: 所以就是这样。哦，然后它还有一个更大的，一个很大的优势，我认为这是那种只有停电时你才会真正注意到的东西。比如，经常会因为变电站停运或一只鸟撞上电线或。世界上很多地方的供电是间歇性的，他们不得不配备使用非常昂贵柴油的发电机。

segments.textEn: But even here in California, we know we're due for the big one. It's been saving up. So there's going to be earthquakes in California, there'll be hurricanes in the Southeast, there'll be ice storms in the Northeast, there's floods. There's all sorts of things that cause electricity interruption. And we're very dependent on electronic devices. So people might say, well, it's not a problem, I'll call 911. Well, how are you going to do that if your phone is dead?
segments.textZh: 但即使在加利福尼亚州这里，我们也知道那场大地震该来了。它已经积蓄很久了。所以加利福尼亚州会发生地震，东南部会有飓风，东北部会有冰暴，还会有洪水。各种各样的事情都会导致供电中断。而我们非常依赖电子设备。所以人们可能会说，嗯，这不是问题，我会拨打 911。可是，如果你的手机没电了，你要怎么拨打？

segments.textEn: Okay, that's real hard. And you know, if all your devices are gone because of power outage, we're so dependent on devices these days that it's actually a significant safety and security concern. So the nice thing about having the powerwall, particularly the Powerwall 2 is that it's like having an uninterruptible power supply for your house. And like I said, it's like my insurance. It's sort of like the kind of thing that when you need it, you really need it.
segments.textZh: 好吧，那真的很难。而且你知道，如果因为停电，你所有的设备都用不了了，我们如今如此依赖设备，这实际上会构成重大的安全与安保隐患。所以，拥有 Powerwall 的好处，尤其是 Powerwall 2，就在于它相当于为你的房子配备了一套不间断电源。而且就像我说的，它就像我的保险。这有点像那种东西：当你需要它时，你真的很需要它。

segments.textEn: And so I think that's an important advantage that is sometimes overlooked.
segments.textZh: 所以我认为，这是一个有时会被忽视的重要优势。

segments.textEn: And we've got the power pack side. This is for big utility scale installations as well, as I should point out, a very important market which is commercial and industrial. So we've done some of the biggest, in fact, maybe the, I think the biggest, still the biggest battery installation in the world in Southern California. And that took over from what was a natural gas peaker. And that's an operation stonewall. We've got a huge system in Hawaii, in Kauai, which is responsible for 20% of Kauai's peak power generation.
segments.textZh: 然后我们还有 Powerpack 这一块。这也是面向大型公用事业规模的设施，另外我应该指出，还有一个非常重要的市场，也就是商业和工业市场。所以我们完成了一些规模最大的项目，事实上，可能是，我认为是最大的，至今仍是全球最大的电池设施，就在南加利福尼亚。它取代了原来的一座天然气调峰电站。那是一项 Stonewall 行动。我们在夏威夷的考艾岛有一套庞大的系统，负责考艾岛峰值发电量的 20%。

segments.textEn: And then we've got a system in American Samoa which powers the whole island. It's totally off grid. And I think that's a great example of the potential, because in the limit, a continent is a big island. Okay, this is a big island, but it's called a continent. If you can make, if you can, if you take an island and have that completely run on solar and batteries, you can do that with a continent.
segments.textZh: 然后，我们在美属萨摩亚还有一套为整座岛屿供电的系统。它完全脱离电网。我认为这是展现其潜力的一个绝佳例子，因为归根结底，大陆就是一座大岛。好吧，这是一座大岛，但它被称为大陆。如果你能让，如果你能，如果你拿一座岛，让它完全依靠太阳能和电池运行，那么你也能在一片大陆上做到这一点。

segments.textEn: So the potential there, I think is incredibly exciting.
segments.textZh: 所以我认为，那里的潜力令人无比兴奋。

So now you can see the powerwall is on there and solar. So you can see the status of your powerwall. You can see what your. Whether your solar system is functioning well, how much energy you're producing.
segments.textZh: 我现在要说的是，在最新版的手机应用中，我们已经把 Powerwall 和太阳能整合进了 Tesla 应用。所以现在你可以看到，就产品列表而言，它不再只显示车辆，而是显示产品。所以现在你能看到里面的 Powerwall 和太阳能。你可以查看 Powerwall 的状态。你可以看到你的。你的太阳能系统是否运行良好，以及你正在生产多少能源。

segments.textEn: It'll show you how much energy you're producing, how much is being stored, how much is being consumed, and then how that relates to the car. segments.textZh: 它会向你显示你正在产生多少能源、储存了多少、消耗了多少，以及这些与你的汽车有何关联。因此，你会拥有一个整合得非常好的系统，将太阳能、储能和你的车辆结合在一起。而且我认为，未来还会有一些其他东西，可能也是人们没有预料到的。

segments.textEn: So you can see your energy usage during the day. So you can tell if maybe you should be turning off certain devices or reprogramming your air conditioning system. And it gives you a good idea of like where you're using power that you may not even realize that you're using.
segments.textZh: 所以你可以查看自己在一天中的能源使用情况。这样你就能判断是否应该关闭某些设备，或者重新设置空调系统。它还能让你清楚地了解，你在哪些地方用了电，而你甚至可能都没有意识到自己在那里用电。

segments.textEn: And if you are drawing energy from the grid, it'll tell you how much energy you drew from the grid and how much you powered yourself. segments.textZh: 如果你正在从电网获取能源，它会告诉你从电网获取了多少能源，以及你自己供应了多少能源。所以我认为它，而且这项功能只会变得越来越好。这是目前已经能够运行的功能。所以这不是推测。这就是目前具备这些功能的应用程序。
